title: Three requests in one email: delivery moved later, payment terms, PP samples
subject: LB-3308: ex-factory, payment, PP samples
body:
Hej Karthik,

Three things for LB-3308:

1. Our warehouse is full in early February, so please move the ex-factory to 19 February 2027.
2. Payment will be by LC at sight; our bank will issue it this week.
3. Please courier 2 PP samples per colour before bulk cutting.

Best,
Elin
Lindqvist & Berg AB
